newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Record month for air passengers in Macau.
newsitem.headline: Record month for air passengers in Macau.

text.p: Macau International airport Company(CAM) set a new traffic record during February and over the Chinese New Year holiday with 150,772 passengers, CAM said in a statement.

It added cargo traffic was also been strong in a traditionally post-Christmas quiet period with 4,700 tonnes handled during January and February, representing a 1,000 per cent increase over the same period in 1996 shortly after the Portuguese enclave's airport opened.

The statement said the February passenger total was boosted by holiday traffic and additional charter flights over the Chinese New Year period. Regular airlines also operated extra flights and used higher capacity aircraft.
CAM said since the beginning of the year 268,754 passengers have used the airport compared to 97,050 passengers in 1996.
Joao Sousa Moreira, CAM chairman of the Board of Directors of CAM said 1.6 million passengers have now used the airport since it opened, a figure which is well ahead of expectations.
